strata: LC2018 categorical grid mode x MAT tertile x annual precipitation tertile x elevation tertile
minimum_support: 10 grid-years in each context/exposure cell, 5 unique grids per context
standardization_weights: unique-grid counts pooled across both contexts within each retained stratum; shared across 4 exposure/context cells
bootstrap: 300 paired grid resamples on fixed retained strata and fixed stratum weights; no silent renormalization for empty bootstrap cells
quantiles: HDSI quartiles on available covariate sample before restriction to permanent and seasonal
caution: within-stratum residual confounding remains; original distance grouping
